The video, played on the second day of a preliminary hearing for accused Tyler Robinson in a Utah court, also appears to show the suspect jumping off the roof while holding an object. Robinson, 23, is accused of fatally shooting Kirk on 10 September 2025 as the conservative activist addressed an audience on the campus of Utah Valley University. The preliminary hearing, which is expected to continue all week, will determine whether there is sufficient evidence for Robinson to stand trial.
The preliminary hearing will determine whether Tyler Robinson, accused of killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk, will stand trial.

Utah county attorney’s office says evidence against suspect Tyler James Robinson is sufficient for case to move to trial Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email Utah prosecutors on Tuesday showed video from the day of Charlie Kirk’s killing that they said depicted suspect Tyler James Robinson entering the Utah Valley University campus and climbing on to a roof where they say he fired a fatal shot at the conservative commentator. The Utah county attorney’s office presented the evidence on the second day of a week-long preliminary hearing in which the state must prove to a state district judge that there was enough evidence for the case to move to trial.

On the first day of the hearing, Christopher Bagley, a former Utah Valley University police officer, described hearing a gunshot while Kirk was speaking to thousands of people on 10 September 2025, and the panic that ensued. “Everybody kind of got up. A lot of people were screaming and starting to run in all different directions,” Bagley told the court. He searched for additional victims, but finding none, moved to contain the scene to preserve evidence, he said. Shortly after, Bagley inspected the rooftop of a nearby building and saw impressions in the gravel that he believed suggested a sniper had been there. The prosecution also submitted graphic footage of the shooting itself into evidence that was not shown to the public.

[Lähde: BBC World]
Watch: New video shows man believed to be Tyler Robinson before Charlie Kirk shooting

Prosecutors have released new surveillance footage that they say shows the man accused of killing Charlie Kirk running across a rooftop after last year's fatal shooting.

The video, played on the second day of a preliminary hearing for accused Tyler Robinson in a Utah court, also appears to show the suspect jumping off the roof while holding an object.

Robinson, 23, is accused of fatally shooting Kirk on 10 September 2025 as the conservative activist addressed an audience on the campus of Utah Valley University.

The preliminary hearing, which is expected to continue all week, will determine whether there is sufficient evidence for Robinson to stand trial.

Robinson faces multiple charges, including aggravated murder in connection with the shooting. He has not yet entered a plea, and his lawyers have objected to much of the video evidence.

Prosecutors in the case are seeking the death penalty.

Prosecution witness David Hull, Utah's State Bureau of Investigation's lead investigator on the case, walked the court through the security footage on Tuesday.

The footage shows the man, allegedly Robinson, appeared repeatedly on campus on the day of the killing, Hull testified.

Erika Kirk comes face-to-face in court with husband's alleged killer

Hull said that surveillance footage showed Robinson's vehicle entering a campus parking garage, before a man wearing a maroon shirt, Converse shoes and grey or olive shorts was seen walking across campus.

The same man was later seen returning to campus, buying food from Chick-fil-A and heading into a wooded area near the university, Hull said.

When he reappeared on campus, around 90 minutes before the shooting, the man was wearing different clothes and seemingly walking with a limp, according to the witness.

Footage then showed the suspect making his way to the Losee Building on the campus and rolling over a railing onto the rooftop.

Shortly after the fatal shot rang out, the same man can be seen running across the roof, dropping down with an unknown object in his hands and making his way off campus, Hull testified.

A rifle was later recovered "in the wooded area where we believe Mr Robinson entered the wooded area", Hull told the court.

[Lähde: The Guardian]
Utah county attorney’s office says evidence against suspect Tyler James Robinson is sufficient for case to move to trial

Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email

Utah prosecutors on Tuesday showed video from the day of Charlie Kirk’s killing that they said depicted suspect Tyler James Robinson entering the Utah Valley University campus and climbing on to a roof where they say he fired a fatal shot at the conservative commentator.

The Utah county attorney’s office presented the evidence on the second day of a week-long preliminary hearing in which the state must prove to a state district judge that there was enough evidence for the case to move to trial.

Robinson, 23, has been charged with aggravated murder in the killing of Kirk, who died after being shot in the neck while speaking at the Utah university last September.

Prosecutors are seeking the death penalty against Robinson, and say there is DNA evidence that links him to the weapon believed to be used in the killing. The state has also said Robinson allegedly confessed in a note he left his roommate and romantic partner. Robinson has not yet entered a plea in the case.

The proceedings this week marked the first time Kirk’s family and his widow, Erika Kirk, have been in the courtroom with his accused killer. Donald Trump Jr, a close friend of Kirk’s, was also in attendance on Monday.

On the first day of the hearing, Christopher Bagley, a former Utah Valley University police officer, described hearing a gunshot while Kirk was speaking to thousands of people on 10 September 2025, and the panic that ensued.

“Everybody kind of got up. A lot of people were screaming and starting to run in all different directions,” Bagley told the court.

He searched for additional victims, but finding none, moved to contain the scene to preserve evidence, he said. Shortly after, Bagley inspected the rooftop of a nearby building and saw impressions in the gravel that he believed suggested a sniper had been there.

The prosecution also submitted graphic footage of the shooting itself into evidence that was not shown to the public.

Tuesday’s proceedings began with David Hull, a former Utah state bureau of investigation agent, taking the stand. Hull narrated what was unfolding in videos played in court that he said showed Robinson arriving on campus, leaving and then returning later in different clothing.

payload.title: Uutta valvontavideota esitettiin Charlie Kirkin surmaa koskevassa kuulemisessa Utahissa
payload.summary: Utahin syyttäjät esittivät alustavassa kuulemisessa valvontavideota, jonka he sanovat näyttävän Tyler Robinsonin liikkuneen Utah Valley Universityn kampuksella ja katolla ennen Charlie Kirkin kuolemaan johtanutta ampumista.
payload.content:
Utahin syyttäjät ovat esittäneet oikeudessa uutta valvontavideota, jonka he sanovat näyttävän konservatiivivaikuttaja Charlie Kirkin surmasta syytetyn Tyler Robinsonin liikkuneen Utah Valley Universityn kampuksella ja katolla ampumisen yhteydessä. Alustavassa kuulemisessa arvioidaan, onko näyttöä riittävästi, jotta asia etenee varsinaiseen oikeudenkäyntiin.

## Video esitettiin kuulemisen toisena päivänä

Syyttäjien mukaan video näyttää miehen, jonka he uskovat olevan 23-vuotias Robinson, juoksevan katon poikki 10. syyskuuta 2025 tapahtuneen ampumisen jälkeen. Videolla henkilön kerrotaan myös näyttävän hyppäävän katolta pitäen kädessään jotakin esinettä.

Toisen kuulemispäivän aikana syyttäjät esittivät lisäksi aineistoa, jonka mukaan Robinson olisi tullut Utah Valley Universityn kampukselle ja noussut rakennuksen katolle. Syyttäjien väitteen mukaan kuolettava laukaus ammuttiin sieltä, kun Kirk puhui yleisölle kampuksella.

Utahin piirikunnan syyttäjänvirasto katsoo, että näyttö Robinsonia vastaan riittää asian viemiseksi oikeudenkäyntiin. Kuulemisen on määrä jatkua koko viikon ajan, ja osavaltion piirituomarin tehtävänä on ratkaista, onko oikeudenkäynnin aloittamiselle riittävä peruste.

## Poliisi kuvasi paniikkia kampuksella

Kuulemisen ensimmäisenä päivänä entinen Utah Valley Universityn poliisi Christopher Bagley kertoi kuulleensa laukauksen Kirkin puhuessa tuhansille ihmisille. Bagleyn mukaan ihmiset nousivat ylös, huusivat ja alkoivat juosta eri suuntiin.

Bagley kertoi etsineensä mahdollisia muita uhreja. Kun niitä ei löytynyt, hän ryhtyi rajaamaan tapahtumapaikkaa todisteiden säilyttämiseksi. Pian tämän jälkeen hän tarkasti läheisen rakennuksen katon ja havaitsi sorassa painaumia, joiden hän uskoi viittaavan siihen, että tarkka-ampuja oli ollut paikalla.

Syyttäjät toimittivat oikeudelle myös ampumista esittävää graafista videomateriaalia, mutta sitä ei näytetty yleisölle. Alustavan kuulemisen keskeinen kysymys on edelleen se, katsooko tuomari syyttäjien esittämän näytön riittävän varsinaiseen käsittelyyn.
summary_bullets: Utahin syyttäjät esittivät uutta valvontavideota Charlie Kirkin surmaa koskevassa kuulemisessa.
Videon väitetään näyttävän Tyler Robinsonin liikkuneen kampuksella ja katolla ampumisen yhteydessä.
Alustavassa kuulemisessa päätetään, riittääkö näyttö asian viemiseksi oikeudenkäyntiin.
